name: Mega Fortune Company Limited Ordinary Shares
summary: Hong Kong-based Mega Fortune Company Limited is a specialist provider of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. Operating through its subsidiary, QBS System, the company offers an extensive range of services, encompassing IoT integration, ongoing maintenance and support, business process outsourcing, and trading solutions. Its primary aim is to assist businesses throughout the Asia-Pacific region in achieving digital transformation, launching new IoT projects, and modernizing outdated systems with cutting-edge IoT technologies.
